headlines.title: Voting Underway in Israel as Netanyahu Faces Battle for Survival
headlines.description: Voting began Tuesday morning across Israel in its first nationwide election since the Oct. 7 attacks of 2023, that is largely viewed as a referendum on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. NBC’s Richard Engel reports for TODAY from Tel Aviv on how the outcome will impact the United States, gas prices and the future of wars in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Melania Trump-brokered ceasefire goes into effect in Ukrainian town ‘on brink of disaster’
headlines.description: The agreement would “temporarily stop all military action in Oleshky to allow for humanitarian aid to enter and to prepare a civilian evacuation,” the White House said.

headlines.title: Mao, memes and Mbappé: Chinese brands drop soccer star in fury over ‘dictator’ joke
headlines.description: He’s one of the world’s most popular athletes, but Kylian Mbappé is suddenly paying the penalty for being on the wrong side of China’s fervent nationalism.

headlines.title: Debbie Shields speaks out on her viral moment riffing with Conan O'Brien
headlines.description: Internet sensation Debbie Shields speaks with NBC News’ Yasmin Vossoughian about her recent viral video, where she stood out during an improvised conversation with Conan O'Brien on the popular internet talk show “Subway Takes.”

headlines.title: Neil Young sues for the second time over Trump’s use of ‘Rockin’ in the Free World’
headlines.description: Rock star Neil Young filed a $10 million lawsuit on Monday over President Donald Trump’s use of his song “Rockin’ in the Free World” at campaign events — the second time the artist has sued over Trump’s use of his music.

headlines.title: Florida police called to youth soccer game after alleged dispute involving 3-year-old player
headlines.description: It was supposed to be a fun weekend soccer game for children.

headlines.title: Alan Dysert, ‘All My Children’ star, dies at 75
headlines.description: Alan Dysert, the actor best known for his role in the television drama “All My Children,” has died, his wife said in a statement.

headlines.title: Damian Lillard has no regrets about the journey that brought him back to Portland
headlines.description: NBA star Damian Lillard requested a trade from the Trail Blazers in 2023. Three years later, he says his detour from Portland was “necessary” to get to where he is today.

headlines.title: Amid 2028 speculation, Wes Moore urges Marylanders to back him on redistricting
headlines.description: Maryland’s Democratic governor is fighting a tough campaign in his state — and it’s not his re-election effort.

headlines.title: Do you really need an exfoliating body wash in your shower routine? Here’s what derms say
headlines.description: Exfoliating body washes help to remove extra dead skin cells that cause acne and dryness — I asked experts whether you actually need one in your routine.
